targetTexts.1: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
targetTexts.2: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers.
targetTexts.3: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, and Hezron the father of Ram.
targetTexts.4: Ram was the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon the father of Salmon.
targetTexts.5: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,
targetTexts.6: and Jesse the father of David the king. Next: David was the father of Solomon by Uriah’s wife,
targetTexts.7: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, and Abijah the father of Asa.
targetTexts.8: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Joram, and Joram the father of Uzziah.
targetTexts.9: Uzziah was the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah.
targetTexts.10: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh, Manasseh the father of Amon, Amon the father of Josiah,
targetTexts.11: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
targetTexts.12: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,
targetTexts.13: Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, Abiud the father of Eliakim, and Eliakim the father of Azor.
targetTexts.14: Azor was the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Achim, and Achim the father of Eliud.
targetTexts.15: Eliud was the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,
targetTexts.16: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
targetTexts.17: In all, then, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Christ.
targetTexts.18: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.
targetTexts.19: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly, he resolved to divorce her quietly.
targetTexts.20: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
targetTexts.21: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”
targetTexts.22: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:
targetTexts.23: “Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel” (which means, “God with us”).
targetTexts.24: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him and embraced Mary as his wife.
targetTexts.25: But he had no union with her until she gave birth to a Son. And he gave Him the name Jesus.
